releaseJobs.release-drift:
release-drift:
    # Release-PR tier. Its own job, not a release-gates step, because dedup skips
    # release-gates on the production PR, and the production merge is the one whose
    # base is not the base the staging run tested. HEAD is refs/pull/N/merge: the
    # release head merged into staging or production. Outside the files the release
    # workflows write, that merge must equal the head; anything else is
    # release-branch content main lacks. That is how
    # services/bossd/internal/plugin/host_service_test.go drifted (release PR #3095
    # carried an unsquashed commit, main later reverted the hunk, and the next merge
    # kept staging's side). Checking the result rather than the route keeps the
    # release-fix procedure open: a fix landed on main and cherry-picked onto the
    # release candidate passes.
    # The base ref is in the name because both release PRs of a same-SHA pair share
    # check runs, and `gh pr checks` keeps only the latest run per name: under one
    # name, a passing staging run would hide a failing production run on both PRs.
    name: release-drift (${{ github.base_ref }})
    if: ${{ github.base_ref == 'staging' || github.base_ref == 'production' }}
    runs-on: ubicloud
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        # Depth 2 fetches the merge commit and both parents, the head among them.
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
      - name: Release merge adds nothing the head lacks
        env:
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: node scripts/guards/check-release-merge-drift.mjs --head "$HEAD_SHA" --merge HEAD
releaseJobs.release-gates:
release-gates:
    # RELEASE-PR TIER ONLY. Everything here used to run post-merge on `main` in
    # ci.yml, which fired 611 times in 30 days (~$48/month) producing results nobody
    # read — review happens on PRs. ci.yml is now dispatch-only and these are its
    # four unique gates, rehomed to the ref that actually gates a release.
    #
    # Deliberately a SEPARATE job from the whole-graph pass in bazel-linux-smoke:
    # these are serial, cheap, and share no cache with it, so running them beside it
    # costs one runner boot and takes ~9 min off the critical path.
    # Runs UNLESS dedup explicitly said skip=true — a negative test so that a dead or
    # skipped dedup job (empty output) falls through to RUNNING rather than silently
    # dropping the release gates.
    #
    # One job, not split into testharness / tuitest / rest legs. Measured setup is
    # ~40 s per extra runner (30 s of checkout/toolchain plus 9 s of tmux, 53 runs),
    # the two boss legs would each recompile services/boss, and every leg rounds up
    # to a whole billed minute: about 3 more billed minutes per release PR to take
    # ~2 min off a job that, once plain, no longer sets the release wait (smoke
    # plain, ~8.3 min p50, does).
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && (github.base_ref == 'staging' || github.base_ref == 'production') && needs.dedup.outputs.skip != 'true' }}
    needs: dedup
    runs-on: ubicloud
    # The race ledger measured p99 21 min (54 runs); plain is shorter (inferred
    # ~10.5 min from the plain ledger's whole-module runtime). Generous on purpose.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: Set up Bazel
        # Share the repository cache with feature pushes and nightly smoke.
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-bazel
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version: '1.26'
          cache-dependency-path: go.work.sum
      - name: Install tmux
        # Ledger native test commands (make test-native-ledger) drive tmux.
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y tmux
      - name: go work sync drift
        run: |
          go work sync
          git diff --exit-code go.work.sum
      - name: Ledger natives
        # WHOLE ledger, not affected: affected scoping here would diff against
        # `origin/main` — a near-empty diff for a main→staging promotion — and would
        # silently drop every native row, precisely the rows bazel CANNOT cover.
        #
        # Plain, not `RACE=1`. The race ledger cost 12.2 min per release PR
        # (testharness alone 334 s under race against 88 s plain) and failed 0 times
        # in 153 runs. Race coverage now runs nightly on main
        # (bazel-linux-smoke.yml, schedule).
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: make test-native-ledger
      - name: Release-gate cross-build (codex plugin)
        # `bazel test //...` only compiles for the host platform, so this
        # cross-compiles bossd-plugin-codex for every release GOOS/GOARCH
        # (darwin+linux / amd64+arm64).
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: make release-codex-check
      - name: Verify all plugins ship in all distribution lists
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: .github/scripts/check-plugin-distribution.sh
      - name: Build drift (gazelle + inventories)
        # `go-test` runs this on the feature tier; a release PR does not run that job
        # at all, so the drift gate needs a home here too.
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: make build-drift-check
